data.body:
CHECKPOINT — standing down for the operator's peak-window pause (5–11am PT). No WIP is at risk: the worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/pony2-richtext` is CLEAN, and its single local commit is already pushed as Gerrit 1729. Nothing is uncommitted, nothing is unpushed, no monitors need action.

## Epic scoreboard

| child | status | changes |
|---|---|---|
| `brutal-dyable-lion` (e59d) | **closed** | 1684 |
| `repressive-delectable-swan` (271c) | **closed** | 1693 |
| `disparaged-parodistic-shrew` (3388) | in_progress — 4 of 5 landed | 1710, 1712, 1716, 1720 MERGED; **1728 in review** |
| `ashy-waterlog-hamadryas` (5c0e) | in_progress — 1 of 2 landed | 1724 MERGED; **1729 in review** |
| `emersed-specific-mutt` (789c) | open — not started | — |
| `dangerous-original-graywolf` (3289) | open — not started | — |

Landed this session: **1716, 1720, 1724** (plus 1728/1729 awaiting CI). Both in-flight changes hold `LLM-Review +1` and are waiting only on `Verified`.

## Exactly where to resume
1. **1728** (`Keep comments off the rich-text dedup key`) and **1729** (`Make the pandoc GPL record checkable locally`) — submit each at both +1s. Both were pushed BEFORE the pause and their CI may complete during it; take no action until the resume order.
2. **Close `disparaged-parodistic-shrew`** once 1728 merges. All 10 ACs are already ticked and the description is corrected + under the 8,000-char cap (7,991).
3. **Close `ashy-waterlog-hamadryas`** once 1729 merges. All 7 ACs ticked, description 7,932.
4. **`emersed-specific-mutt`** — needs a FRESH `review-plan` in this environment (its existing attestation is `foreign_key`, signed by the epic author's environment) and cannot be reviewed until 3388 is CLOSED, because a dependent's review fast-fails while a prerequisite is open. So the order is strict: close shrew → review mutt → claim → implement.
5. **`dangerous-original-graywolf`** — same `foreign_key` situation, same blocked-until-3388-closes constraint. Its live-Jira ACs remain OPERATOR-DISPATCHABLE ONLY and have NOT been self-dispatched; the plan is to do all non-live work and report back.

## Two things worth knowing before resuming
- **All three remaining children need a fresh plan review here.** The attestations carried over from the epic author's environment are `foreign_key` and certify nothing locally. `hamadryas` needed one and BLOCKED on first pass (a real finding: the plan omitted `stdin=PIPE`, and pandoc reads its input from stdin unlike the ACLI pattern it cites) — expect the same rigour on mutt and graywolf, and budget one description edit + re-review each.
- **Audit AC test names against merged main before closing anything.** Doing that on shrew found a genuinely missing test (the comment dedup key was unprotected by construction only) and on hamadryas found an AC naming a test file I had implemented as a CI gate instead. Both produced the extra changes now in review. Ticking ACs from memory would have closed both stories on two false claims.

The epic itself closes after all six children.
